clips.title: The story
paras: The Cathedral of Light rises over Cathedral Square as Stormwind's chief sanctuary of the Church of the Holy Light. It is the spiritual heart of the city and the center of human priesthood and the Knights of the Silver Hand.

Archbishop Benedictus leads the faithful from the Cathedral of Light, rebuilt after the First War's devastation. Archbishop Alonsus Faol and Bishop Benedictus guided its restoration, and its towering form remains a beacon of resilience. After the Scourge took Lordaeron during the Third War, the Church moved its seat south to Stormwind. From this great hall, Benedictus gives spiritual guidance to the Alliance.

The Cathedral of Light is both a place of prayer and healing and the main headquarters of the Knights of the Silver Hand in the southern kingdoms. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Duthorian Rall train promising squires through the sacred trials of the Tome of Valor and the Tome of Divinity. High Priestess Laurena guides devout acolytes in the deepest tenets of the Light, preparing holy champions to defend the realm from the growing threats of the Defias Brotherhood and the Scourge.
